purpose: Learn a probability that a first-pass annotation is incorrect or will benefit from refinement, then allocate a fixed second-pass LLM budget to the highest-risk clusters.

optimization_objective.definition: S_star = argmax_{|S| <= k} sum_{i in S} E[Delta_i]
optimization_objective.delta_i: Expected annotation improvement after refinement for cluster i.
optimization_objective.risk_k_approximation: Rank clusters by predicted first-pass error risk or predicted refinement benefit and select the top k.

selector.name: Risk-k
selector.ranking_rule: Select the k clusters with the highest predicted risk or refinement-benefit probability.
selector.budget_rule: Use the same per-dataset-replicate refinement budget as Evidence-k unless an explicit budget is prespecified.
selector.tie_breaking_rule: Ties are resolved by input cluster order after first-pass parsing.

training_protocol.input_source: paired benchmark debug files with cached first-pass responses and FullRefined outcomes when available
training_protocol.leakage_rule: Do not train or tune on held-out external-validation datasets.

external_validation_rule: Freeze the trained model RDS and its MD5 hash before running held-out external validation.
